coa.title: Northwestern sets tuition and fees for the 2026-2027 academic year | Northwestern Now
quotes: Northwestern University announced a 3.5% increase in undergraduate tuition for the 2026-2027 school year. Undergraduate tuition will be $71,802; standard room and board will be $22,941; and fees will be $1,260.
